Every composition starts as a preset, then becomes fully editable. Drag either side to resize and reposition the text box, drag a corner to scale the lockup, or select Whole composition to move everything together. Frames and rules follow the box.
Center X · from leftSelect an item
Center Y · from topSelect an item
Dragging
Alignment
Center coordinates use the 12 × 15 in artwork canvas. Drag items directly on the shirt; strong guides appear when centers or matching edges align. Up to 20 moves, resizes, additions, removals, or scale changes are kept. Use Ctrl or Command + Z to undo, and add Shift to redo. Arrow keys nudge one grid step; Shift moves four steps and Alt bypasses snapping.

Review your production files

Editable SVG · font check required
Print checkRun the live checks before production.
Print SVG, fitted SVG, and PNG keep transparent backgrounds. Solid modes convert lettering, decorations, and recolorable built-in artwork; uploaded artwork keeps its source colors. Many professional garment methods can print white, while dark modes support workflows that cannot.

The print SVG keeps the generic 12 × 15 inch transparent artboard for placement. The fitted SVG trims the canvas to the artwork with a 5 px transparent margin. SVG text remains editable and depends on font availability; convert it to outlines for an exact print handoff. The transparent 3600 × 4500 PNG embeds selected hosted fonts and is tagged at 300 PPI; locally activated fonts still need visual confirmation.
